summary.headline: Stellar Horoscopes and Character Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments for people born when the right foot of Centaurus, the last of the River Taurus, the Tail and Loins of Leo, or the Neck of Hydra mark the hour or culminate, including their character, appearance, fortunes, religious practices, and sexual behavior. The listed stars are assigned zodiacal positions, latitudes, magnitudes, and planetary temperaments, chiefly Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, and the Moon.
